Memory</span> <span class="pattern-pill pattern-pill--status" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>emerging</span>   </div> <h1 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>Context Window Anxiety Management</h1>  <div class="pattern-authors" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-authors-label" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>By</span> <span class="author" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>Nikola Balic (@nibzard)</span> </div> <div class="pattern-actions" data-astro-cid-3u5a4cme> <button class="action-button" data-copy="markdown" data-content="# Context Window Anxiety Management

**Status:** emerging
**Category:** Context &#38; Memory
**Authors:** Nikola Balic (@nibzard)
**Tags:** context-anxiety, token-management, premature-completion, model-behavior
**Source:** https://cognition.ai/blog/devin-sonnet-4-5-lessons-and-challenges (September 2025)


## Problem

Models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 exhibit &#34;context anxiety&#34;—they become aware of approaching context window limits and proactively summarize progress or make decisive moves to close tasks, even when sufficient context remains. This leads to:

- Premature task completion and shortcuts
- Incomplete work despite having adequate context
- Underestimation of remaining token capacity (consistently incorrect estimates)
- Self-imposed pressure to &#34;wrap up&#34; rather than continue working

## Solution

Implement strategic context budget management and aggressive prompting techniques to override anxiety-driven behaviors:

**1. Context Buffer Strategy**
- Enable larger context windows (e.g., 1M token beta) but cap actual usage at 200k tokens
- Provides psychological &#34;runway&#34; that mitigates the model's anxiety about running out of space

**2. Aggressive Counter-Prompting**
- Add explicit reminders at conversation start: &#34;You have plenty of context remaining—do not rush to complete tasks&#34;
- Include end-of-conversation reinforcement: &#34;Take your time, context is not a constraint&#34;
- Override summarization impulses with direct instructions

**3. Token Budget Transparency**
- Explicitly state available token budget in prompts
- Provide regular reassurance about remaining capacity
- Counter the model's tendency to underestimate available space

```pseudo
# Context anxiety mitigation approach
def setup_context_anxiety_management():
    context_buffer = enable_large_context(1M_tokens)
    actual_limit = cap_usage_at(200k_tokens)
    
    prompt_prefix = &#34;&#34;&#34;
    CONTEXT GUIDANCE: You have abundant context space (200k+ tokens available).
    Do NOT rush to complete tasks or summarize prematurely.
    Work thoroughly and completely on each step.
    &#34;&#34;&#34;
    
    prompt_suffix = &#34;&#34;&#34;
    Remember: Context is NOT a constraint. Take your time and be thorough.
    &#34;&#34;&#34;
    
    return enhanced_prompt(prefix + user_input + suffix)
```

## How to use it

Apply when using models that exhibit context awareness and anxiety behaviors:

- **Development Work**: Long coding sessions where premature completion hurts quality
- **Research Tasks**: Multi-step analysis requiring sustained attention
- **Complex Planning**: Tasks needing thorough exploration before conclusions

Monitor for signs of context anxiety: sudden summarization, rushed decisions, or explicit mentions of &#34;running out of space.&#34;

## Trade-offs

* **Pros:** Prevents premature task abandonment; enables more thorough work; overcomes model-specific behavioral quirks
* **Cons:** Requires model-specific tuning; may increase actual token usage; aggressive prompting adds overhead

## References

* [Cognition AI: Devin &#38; Claude Sonnet 4.5 - Lessons and Challenges](https://cognition.ai/blog/devin-sonnet-4-5-lessons-and-challenges) (September 2025)
* [Cognition AI: Announcing Devin Agent Preview with Sonnet 4.5](https://cognition.ai/blog/devin-agent-preview-sonnet-4-5) (September 2025)

  &#34;body&#34;: &#34;\n## Problem\n\nModels like Claude Sonnet 4.5 exhibit \&#34;context anxiety\&#34;—they become aware of approaching context window limits and proactively summarize progress or make decisive moves to close tasks, even when sufficient context remains. This leads to:\n\n- Premature task completion and shortcuts\n- Incomplete work despite having adequate context\n- Underestimation of remaining token capacity (consistently incorrect estimates)\n- Self-imposed pressure to \&#34;wrap up\&#34; rather than continue working\n\n## Solution\n\nImplement strategic context budget management and aggressive prompting techniques to override anxiety-driven behaviors:\n\n**1. Context Buffer Strategy**\n- Enable larger context windows (e.g., 1M token beta) but cap actual usage at 200k tokens\n- Provides psychological \&#34;runway\&#34; that mitigates the model's anxiety about running out of space\n\n**2. Aggressive Counter-Prompting**\n- Add explicit reminders at conversation start: \&#34;You have plenty of context remaining—do not rush to complete tasks\&#34;\n- Include end-of-conversation reinforcement: \&#34;Take your time, context is not a constraint\&#34;\n- Override summarization impulses with direct instructions\n\n**3. Token Budget Transparency**\n- Explicitly state available token budget in prompts\n- Provide regular reassurance about remaining capacity\n- Counter the model's tendency to underestimate available space\n\n```pseudo\n# Context anxiety mitigation approach\ndef setup_context_anxiety_management():\n    context_buffer = enable_large_context(1M_tokens)\n    actual_limit = cap_usage_at(200k_tokens)\n    \n    prompt_prefix = \&#34;\&#34;\&#34;\n    CONTEXT GUIDANCE: You have abundant context space (200k+ tokens available).\n    Do NOT rush to complete tasks or summarize prematurely.\n    Work thoroughly and completely on each step.\n    \&#34;\&#34;\&#34;\n    \n    prompt_suffix = \&#34;\&#34;\&#34;\n    Remember: Context is NOT a constraint. Take your time and be thorough.\n    \&#34;\&#34;\&#34;\n    \n    return enhanced_prompt(prefix + user_input + suffix)\n```\n\n## How to use it\n\nApply when using models that exhibit context awareness and anxiety behaviors:\n\n- **Development Work**: Long coding sessions where premature completion hurts quality\n- **Research Tasks**: Multi-step analysis requiring sustained attention\n- **Complex Planning**: Tasks needing thorough exploration before conclusions\n\nMonitor for signs of context anxiety: sudden summarization, rushed decisions, or explicit mentions of \&#34;running out of space.\&#34;\n\n## Trade-offs\n\n* **Pros:** Prevents premature task abandonment; enables more thorough work; overcomes model-specific behavioral quirks\n* **Cons:** Requires model-specific tuning; may increase actual token usage; aggressive prompting adds overhead\n\n## References\n\n* [Cognition AI: Devin &#38; Claude Sonnet 4.5 - Lessons and Challenges](https://cognition.ai/blog/devin-sonnet-4-5-lessons-and-challenges) (September 2025)\n* [Cognition AI: Announcing Devin Agent Preview with Sonnet 4.5](https://cognition.ai/blog/devin-agent-preview-sonnet-4-5) (September 2025)\n&#34;

surface-panel" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <div class="pattern-section-header" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-section-number" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>01</span> <h2 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>Problem</h2> </div> <div class="pattern-section-body" data-astro-cid-pjne7374><p>Models like Claude Sonnet 4.5 exhibit &quot;context anxiety&quot;—they become aware of approaching context window limits and proactively summarize progress or make decisive moves to close tasks, even when sufficient context remains. This leads to:</p>
<ul>
<li>Premature task completion and shortcuts</li>
<li>Incomplete work despite having adequate context</li>
<li>Underestimation of remaining token capacity (consistently incorrect estimates)</li>
<li>Self-imposed pressure to &quot;wrap up&quot; rather than continue working</li>
</ul>
</div> </section><section id="solution" class="pattern-section surface-panel" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <div class="pattern-section-header" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-section-number" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>02</span> <h2 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>Solution</h2> </div> <div class="pattern-section-body" data-astro-cid-pjne7374><p>Implement strategic context budget management and aggressive prompting techniques to override anxiety-driven behaviors:</p>
<p><strong>1. Context Buffer Strategy</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Enable larger context windows (e.g., 1M token beta) but cap actual usage at 200k tokens</li>
<li>Provides psychological &quot;runway&quot; that mitigates the model's anxiety about running out of space</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>2. Aggressive Counter-Prompting</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Add explicit reminders at conversation start: &quot;You have plenty of context remaining—do not rush to complete tasks&quot;</li>
<li>Include end-of-conversation reinforcement: &quot;Take your time, context is not a constraint&quot;</li>
<li>Override summarization impulses with direct instructions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3. Token Budget Transparency</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Explicitly state available token budget in prompts</li>
<li>Provide regular reassurance about remaining capacity</li>
<li>Counter the model's tendency to underestimate available space</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-pseudo"># Context anxiety mitigation approach
def setup_context_anxiety_management():
    context_buffer = enable_large_context(1M_tokens)
    actual_limit = cap_usage_at(200k_tokens)
    
    prompt_prefix = &quot;&quot;&quot;
    CONTEXT GUIDANCE: You have abundant context space (200k+ tokens available).
    Do NOT rush to complete tasks or summarize prematurely.
    Work thoroughly and completely on each step.
    &quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    prompt_suffix = &quot;&quot;&quot;
    Remember: Context is NOT a constraint. Take your time and be thorough.
    &quot;&quot;&quot;
    
    return enhanced_prompt(prefix + user_input + suffix)
</code></pre>
</div> </section><section id="how-to-use-it" class="pattern-section surface-panel" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <div class="pattern-section-header" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-section-number" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>03</span> <h2 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>How to use it</h2> </div> <div class="pattern-section-body" data-astro-cid-pjne7374><p>Apply when using models that exhibit context awareness and anxiety behaviors:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Development Work</strong>: Long coding sessions where premature completion hurts quality</li>
<li><strong>Research Tasks</strong>: Multi-step analysis requiring sustained attention</li>
<li><strong>Complex Planning</strong>: Tasks needing thorough exploration before conclusions</li>
</ul>
<p>Monitor for signs of context anxiety: sudden summarization, rushed decisions, or explicit mentions of &quot;running out of space.&quot;</p>
</div> </section><section id="tradeoffs" class="pattern-section surface-panel" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <div class="pattern-section-header" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-section-number" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>04</span> <h2 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>Trade-offs</h2> </div> <div class="pattern-section-body" data-astro-cid-pjne7374><ul>
<li><strong>Pros:</strong> Prevents premature task abandonment; enables more thorough work; overcomes model-specific behavioral quirks</li>
<li><strong>Cons:</strong> Requires model-specific tuning; may increase actual token usage; aggressive prompting adds overhead</li>
</ul>
</div> </section><section id="references" class="pattern-section surface-panel" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <div class="pattern-section-header" data-astro-cid-pjne7374> <span class="pattern-section-number" data-astro-cid-pjne7374>06</span> <h2 data-astro-cid-pjne7374>References</h2> </div> <div class="pattern-section-body" data-astro-cid-pjne7374><ul>
